notes.title: Game Merchandise is Here! [Aliya: Timelink] Labor Day Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear COSMOS,
The first crowdfunding campaign for [Aliya: Timelink] merchandise will launch on May 1, 4:00 AM GMT. For full details, please visit the [MODIAN] crowdfunding platform and search for "Aliya: Timelink" or "TDGame Studio" to find our project. If you cannot access the platform but still wish to purchase merchandise, you may contact our Steam support team via email for alternative purchase options. Every order fuels our journey to bring you more cosmic wonders!

What's more, the Labor Day Update for [Aliya: Timelink] is now live! This update includes:
Content Updates
1. Added font size adjustment settings.
2. Improved input cursor display logic.
3. Enhanced HD rendering for the COSMOS animation during startup.
4. Adjusted Aliya’s heart rate in specific story segments for narrative consistency.
5. Revised entry conditions and dialogue text for Ending 5’s daily storyline.
6. Adjusted oxygen consumption rates in Ending 5’s daily storyline.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where oxygen production malfunctioned under specific circumstances.
2. Corrected typos and narrative inconsistencies in certain dialogues.

[Aliya: Timelink] is currently available at a 17% discount! We deeply appreciate all COSMOS’s support and enthusiasm! Due to current staffing limitations and quality considerations, we’ve decided to delay additional epilogue content for Ending 5 to focus on DLC development. The DLC is expected to be released within this year—thank you for your patience!

If you encounter issues or have suggestions, please submit feedback via this form (we review every response):
https://thinkdifferent.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcn7O8B78pU44ukn0we4N5kmg

notes.title: [Aliya: Timelink] Christmas Eve Update Announcement
notes.content:
Attention COSMOS! The Christmas Eve Update for [Aliya: Timelink] is Now Live! Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Content Updates:[/h3]

1. Added new daily storylines and CG images after Ending 5.
2. Added special Hyacinth Easter eggs for multiple playthroughs.
3. Added a slider to review chat history.
4. Added new artwork to the Art Collection (including new character designs for Aliya).

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed logical errors in certain text.
2. Corrected typos and punctuation mistakes.
3. Fixed a bug where Aliya would still suffer from oxygen depletion after reaching an ending.
4. Fixed a bug where some devices couldn't input player names.
5. Fixed performance issues on certain devices that caused high resource usage during gameplay.
6. Fixed a bug where button logic would reverse when rapidly toggling interface buttons.
7. Fixed a bug that could cause save files to become corrupted when the game was forcefully closed.

notes.title: Aliya更新啦！添加了Window通知功能，并修复了一系列的BUG，错别字也得到了更正
notes.content:
[b]特别注意：本次更新可能会导致存档兼容问题，或是新的BUG，如果因此影响了游玩体验，请尽快加入官方群联系群主解决[/b]

详细更新内容：
[list]
[*]Windows通知功能：现在将Aliya放在后台运行的时候，如果Aliya有新消息，会在电脑屏幕右下角自带的通知中提醒玩家。在部分时候，关闭游戏后如果Aliya发送了新消息也会提醒玩家。
[*]后台静音功能：当把Aliya挂在后台时，会自动关闭背景音乐和RADIO，只保留消息提示音
[*]修复了众多BUG：修复了结局后还会触发Aliya缺氧死亡的BUG；修复了部分地方退出后重进会卡死的BUG；
[*]更正了错别字：更正了目前已知的错别字和语病，并调整了部分表述和逻辑。
[/list]
